Use cases

## What you can build with SpotDraft

From CRM integrations to automated contract pipelines, SpotDraft's API and webhooks help your product or internal system create contracts, update metadata, sync documents, and react to lifecycle events.

[Deal closed **CRM Integrations** \\
Create a contract when a deal closes and sync signed metadata back to the CRM record.\\
Open playbook](https://developer.spotdraft.com/docs/api-playbooks/create-a-template-contract-and-sync-data-back) [From your app **Contract Automation** \\
Fill a template from your system, send it for signature, or keep a human step in SpotDraft.\\
Choose a flow](https://developer.spotdraft.com/docs/api-playbooks/choose-a-template-contract-flow) [Send and subscribe **E-Signature Workflows** \\
Start signature from your product and react when documents are sent, signed, or voided.\\
Open playbook](https://developer.spotdraft.com/docs/api-playbooks/create-a-template-contract-and-send-for-signature) [Before signature **Approval Workflows** \\
Subscribe to approval lifecycle events and keep source systems aligned with the current state.\\
See webhook events](https://developer.spotdraft.com/docs/webhooks) [Templates **Document Generation** \\
Generate contracts from SpotDraft templates and structured business data, without manual drafting.\\
Open playbook](https://developer.spotdraft.com/docs/api-playbooks/create-a-template-contract-and-sync-data-back) [Webhooks **Real-Time Notifications** \\
Receive contract lifecycle events and update downstream systems as status and documents change.\\
Open playbook](https://developer.spotdraft.com/docs/api-playbooks/receive-real-time-contract-events-via-webhooks)

Why SpotDraft

## Built for developers, trusted by enterprise teams

Use one portal to understand authentication, regions, core objects, Clickwrap SDK flows, webhook delivery, API limits, and the operational responsibilities needed for a production integration.

### API Reliability

Versioned REST endpoints, clear usage guidelines, and webhook-driven sync help integrations run predictably in production.

### Rich Documentation

Guides, playbooks, and API reference pages cover authentication, regions, core objects, webhooks, and debugging workflows.

### SDK & Webhook Support

Use the Clickwrap SDK for embedded acceptance flows and webhooks for real-time contract lifecycle updates.

### Enterprise Security

Workspace-scoped credentials, signed webhooks, and regional hosts. Webhook delivery logs are in the product UI; API logs are not exposed.
